meta.title: "Implement missing members" helper doesn't parenthesise compound traits behind references
meta.fix_ref: rust-lang/rust-analyzer#22741 (fix: add parens in transformed dyn type in ref type)
meta.build_notes: GitHub release assets rust-analyzer-aarch64-apple-darwin.gz of the weekly tags 2026-07-06 and 2026-07-13; git tag --contains puts the fix first in 2026-07-13. The sysroot is the local rustup toolchain (rustc 1.98.1).
meta.notes: The assist substitutes the trait's type parameter T in '&T' by 'dyn 'a + B' without parentheses; '&dyn 'a + B' is a syntax error (ambiguous '+' in a type). Reported in 2021, fixed in 2026-07.

settings_note: The issue names no settings; the session keeps checkOnSave off (native analysis only).

files.note: a library crate around the snippet (package name, version, edition 2021)

repro.steps: Open src/lib.rs. On the impl 'impl<'a, T: B> A<dyn 'a + B> for T {}' (cursor between the braces, line 5, character 36) apply the assist 'Implement missing members'. Reported: the generated signature 'fn a(&self) -> &dyn 'a + B' is a syntax error; expected '&(dyn 'a + B)'. Probe: the edited text must have no parse error that the original did not have.
